sample_unit: chest radiograph images read by 25 physicians (20 non-experts, 5 experts)

links.outcome: Reader sensitivity, specificity, accuracy and ROC-AUC without versus with AI assistance, non-experts and experts
links.effect: Non-expert ROC-AUC 0.795 to 0.825 (p=0.005); sensitivity 0.744 to 0.802 (p=0.003); no sensitivity change in experts (p=0.285); specificity and accuracy unchanged.
links.quote: After using BMAX, sensitivity was improved from 0.744 (95% CI; 0.697 to 0.791) to 0.802 (95% CI; 0.754 to 0.850) among non-experts (p=0.003), but not among experts (p=0.285).

screen.reason: The study empirically tests the effect of providing deep learning CAD assistance (BMAX) to non-expert and expert clinicians versus unassisted interpretation in a multireader offline study.

primary.practice: AI-assisted clinician reading vs unassisted reading
